q: What are the exact unit counters in We March as One?
a: Unpacked from Build #26192930 (ShapeWar.UnitTuning): Squares (3g, 28 HP) deal 1.5x damage to Diamonds and take 65% less cavalry damage; Triangles (3g, range 16.5) deal 1.75x damage to Squares; Diamonds (5g, speed 5.0) deal 1.5x damage to Triangles and take 45% less arrow damage. Against late-game Hexagons (1,800 HP, -70% arrow/cavalry armor), Elite Chevrons (1,000g, 400 damage) combine a 1.5x vs-Big bonus with Hexagon's 1.2x bolt vulnerability for 720 effective damage per shot.

q: How much Gold do you earn when you lose a battle in We March as One?
a: According to EconomyTuning in Build #26192930, unclearedKillGold is set to 0.40—meaning every enemy unit your army defeats on an uncleared stage pays 40% of its Gold unit value whether you win or lose, while your fallen troops return intact for the next run.

q: How do you crown The King in We March as One and what does it do?
a: After unlocking THE KING node on the Circle skill tree branch for 160 Gold (prerequisite: Circle Capacity I for 40 Gold), double-click any placed Circle during battle setup. The crowned King gains 10x health (100 HP) and 10x damage (40 damage) while granting nearby friendly units +30% movement and attack speed.

q: Is there a free We March as One demo on Steam?
a: Yes. Alongside the $7.99 full release (Steam AppID 5189160, 50 campaign levels), dux offers the free We March as One Demo (Steam AppID 5403150, Build #26192930) featuring 25 campaign stages, 8 playable shape units, and 62 skill tree upgrades.

q: Are there any We March as One redeem codes?
a: No. We March as One is a single-player Steam strategy auto-battler without an in-game coupon input system. All army unlocks and upgrades come from campaign Gold bounties and the skill tree.

q: What PC specs are required for We March as One?
a: Minimum Windows specs on Steam: Windows 10 64-bit (21H1+), quad-core CPU (Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200), 8 GB RAM, DirectX 11 GPU with 1 GB VRAM, and 2 GB storage.
